Eligibility: Landholding farmer families meeting scheme conditions; institutional landholders, income-tax payers and specified higher-economic-status categories are excluded.
Benefits: ₹6,000 per year in 3 equal instalments through DBT.
Income: No fixed income ceiling; income-tax payers are excluded.
Application: Online farmer registration on PM-KISAN portal; State/UT verification and eKYC.

Scheme Name: Ayushman Bharat – Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
Eligibility: Eligible poor/vulnerable households identified under scheme criteria; eligibility includes specified rural deprivation and urban occupational categories.
Benefits: Cashless hospitalisation cover up to ₹5 lakh per family per year.
Income: No single income ceiling; eligibility is based mainly on deprivation/occupational criteria.
Application: Check eligibility through PM-JAY/myScheme and use an empanelled hospital.

Eligibility: Urban households in EWS/LIG/MIG categories meeting housing and other conditions; family must not own a pucca house.
Benefits: Housing assistance/subsidy depending on component; central assistance can reach ₹2.50 lakh/unit in specified cases and home-loan subsidy up to ₹1.80 lakh under ISS.
Income: EWS up to ₹3 lakh; LIG ₹3–6 lakh; MIG-I ₹6–12 lakh; MIG-II ₹12–18 lakh annual household income.
Application: Online registration through PMAY-U 2.0 portal followed by eligibility check and beneficiary survey.

Eligibility: Eligible rural houseless households and households living in kutcha/dilapidated houses identified through the scheme's deprivation and exclusion criteria.
Benefits: ₹1.20 lakh unit assistance in plain areas and ₹1.30 lakh in North-East/hill areas, with basic amenities.
Income: Household exclusion checks include earning above ₹15,000/month and other economic criteria.
Application: Identification through SECC/Awaas+ processes, Gram Sabha/state verification and scheme portal processes.

Eligibility: Adult woman aged 18+ from an eligible poor household; no other LPG connection should exist in the household.
Benefits: Deposit-free LPG connection support and related connection benefits under PMUY.
Income: Poor-household/deprivation criteria; no single universal income threshold stated on the official PMUY eligibility page.
Category: Women / Clean cooking fuel / Poor households
Application: Apply through an LPG distributor or PMUY online application route with required documents.

Scheme Name: Pradhan Mantri Street Vendor’s AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
Eligibility: Street vendors eligible under the scheme/ULB or survey/LoR requirements.
Benefits: Collateral-free working-capital loans up to ₹15,000, ₹25,000 and ₹50,000 in progressive tranches; interest subsidy and digital incentives.
State/Coverage: Urban, census-town and eligible peri-urban areas across India
Application: Apply through PM SVANidhi portal, participating banks/ULBs/authorized channels.

Eligibility: Artisans/craftspeople working with hands and tools in one of 18 specified traditional trades; registration/verification through the scheme process.
Benefits: Certificate/ID, skill training with stipend, toolkit incentive up to ₹15,000, collateral-free credit up to ₹1 lakh and ₹2 lakh at concessional interest, plus digital/marketing support.
Application: Registration through Common Service Centres using the PM Vishwakarma portal and biometric verification.

Eligibility: Micro enterprises needing institutional credit for eligible non-farm and allied activities; lending subject to participating lender rules.
Benefits: Collateral-free micro-enterprise credit: Shishu up to ₹50,000; Kishore ₹50,000–₹5 lakh; Tarun ₹5–₹10 lakh; Tarun Plus above ₹10 lakh up to ₹20 lakh for eligible repeat borrowers.
Application: Apply through participating banks, NBFCs, MFIs and other Member Lending Institutions.

Eligibility: Indian citizen with savings bank/post-office savings account meeting APY conditions.
Benefits: Guaranteed minimum pension of ₹1,000–₹5,000 per month from age 60, depending on contribution; spouse and nominee benefits also apply.
Income: No fixed income ceiling; current tax-payer restrictions apply to new subscribers under prevailing rules.
Application: Enroll through participating bank/post office using APY enrolment process.

Eligibility: Individual account holder of a participating bank/post office.
Benefits: Accidental death/total disability cover ₹2 lakh; specified partial disability ₹1 lakh; premium ₹20/year.
Application: Enroll through participating bank/post office with consent for auto-debit.

Scheme Name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
Eligibility: Individual account holder of participating bank/post office.
Benefits: Life cover of ₹2 lakh for death due to any cause; annual premium ₹436.
Application: Enroll through participating bank/post office with auto-debit consent.

Eligibility: Guardian can open account for a girl child below 10 years; normally one account per girl child, subject to scheme rules.
Benefits: Government-backed savings account; minimum ₹250 annual deposit, maximum ₹1.5 lakh/year; maturity after 21 years; tax benefits under applicable rules.
Age: Girl child below 10 years at account opening
Application: Open at post office or authorized bank; guardian submits required identity, residence and birth documents.

Eligibility: Eligible pregnant/lactating women from specified socially/economically disadvantaged groups; also includes women meeting listed criteria such as SC/ST, BPL, PM-JAY, e-Shram, MGNREGA or family income below ₹8 lakh/year.
Benefits: ₹5,000 for first child in two instalments; ₹6,000 for second child when the second child is a girl, subject to conditions.
Age: Pregnant/lactating women; no general age limit stated
Income: One eligibility route is net family income below ₹8 lakh/year.
State/Coverage: Pan-India, except Odisha and Telangana currently not implementing PMMVY
Application: Eligible woman can apply through Anganwadi/ASHA worker or directly through PMMVY portal.

Eligibility: Farmers growing notified crops in notified areas and seasons under the scheme; exact crop/area participation is notified by the state.
Benefits: Crop insurance against notified risks; farmer premium capped at 2% for Kharif food/oilseed crops, 1.5% for Rabi food/oilseed crops and 5% for commercial/horticultural crops.
State/Coverage: Participating States/UTs; crop and area notified by state authorities
Application: Apply through official PMFBY portal, authorized agencies/banks/CSCs as applicable.

Eligibility: SC/ST and/or women entrepreneurs aged above 18 setting up a greenfield enterprise; loan available through scheduled commercial bank branches.
Benefits: Bank loans from ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore for eligible greenfield enterprises in manufacturing, services, trading or allied agriculture activities.
Application: Apply at a scheduled commercial bank branch, through Stand-Up India portal or via Lead District Manager.
